scripts.build-proxy: bun run build-folio && bun run build-rivet
scripts.start: bun run build-proxy && NODE_ENV=production bun server/prod.mjs
scripts.dev: bun run build-proxy && NODE_ENV=development bun server/dev.mjs
scripts.dev:web: bun run build-proxy && DEV_AUTOSTART=0 NODE_ENV=development bun server/dev.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && bun run typecheck:rivet && bun run typecheck:folio
scripts.typecheck:folio: tsc --noEmit --project vendor/folio/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --emitDeclarationOnly false --project vendor/folio/packages/core/tsconfig.json && bun run typecheck:folio:core-api && tsc --project vendor/folio/packages/controller/tsconfig.json && bun run typecheck:folio:controller-api && tsc --project vendor/folio/packages/utils/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: bun run build-proxy && vite build --config vite.config.js && bun run audit-build
